Market today: The AI trade is splitting hard, with Meta tanking while Microsoft jumps. This mixed signal, plus news of an AI investor unwinding positions, suggests caution. Big tech earnings from Apple and Amazon after the bell will drive tomorrow's tech mood.

Your holdings: QQQ (-5.02%), SMH (-15.86%), and QQQI (-7.22%) are all on "SELL" status and very close to their stops. Your leveraged SOXL (-55.79%) and SPAL (-55.75%) are deep in the red; margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Apple and Amazon earnings tonight. Their results will heavily influence your tech-heavy book. Also, watch how the AI trade continues to diverge.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your "SELL" positions and leveraged ETFs, especially with major tech earnings on deck.
plays: Respect stops on QQQ (670), SMH (540), and QQQI (52) to protect capital.
Re-evaluate SOXL and SPAL stops; their deep losses and leveraged nature demand immediate attention.
Consider a new long in MSFT given its 15% jump and scanner entry 413.06-402.46, stop 387.39.
